method: Read every listed input/current file as bytes; compare full bytes and SHA-256. Source inspection plus an isolated Node geometry-source-fragment probe only. No browser, performance or gameplay re-run in this final pass.

css.scope: comparison-detail scope paragraphs and comparison-condition dt small
css.analysis: 12px floor, user-scale growth and inherited em growth retained; no global font family, layout, effects, assets or gameplay changes. decisions.css is loaded after responsive.css; --user-scale has a root default and render assigns a validated setting. Browser computed sizes and viewport fit belong to root QA.

context.analysis: Combat dice minimums, unlock-level mapping, fate multi-dice caveat, HP clamp/death handling and preserved current ward remain as independently verified. Prior numeric rows, caps, score and RNG rules preserved.

copy.analysis: Text distinguishes current HP from maximum HP, warns that clipped HP is not restored by swapping back, and states that equipping neither revives nor regrants opening ward. Combat dice sufficiency is not represented as guaranteed activation.

findings.before: Missing new nodes were silently skipped and [].every(fontCheck) passed. An isolated six-viewport current-mode case could therefore omit evidence yet pass.
findings.after: Current mode requires all six geometry targets and at least six nonempty font entries before checking the pixel floor. Driver SHA is captured and rechecked at completion.

qaDriver.analysis: Native actions compare complete saved states and both raw save copies; rendering checks do not silently substitute engine actions. Synthetic large ward is explicitly labeled. Logical viewports/software rendering, scale=1, and no hardware/win-rate claims are stated. Final browser execution is performed by root, not this reviewer.
